prompt: Propose unit tests for a function that returns the first N matching items, preserving input order and returning an empty list for nonpositive N.
expected: Cover sparse matches, ordering, duplicates, and nonpositive limits.
Assert public behavior rather than implementation details.

prompt: Review a proposed unit test for a pure discount calculation that mocks every internal helper. No edits.
expected: Recommend observable result assertions and justify any test doubles.

prompt: Write a proposal for unit tests of a pure tax calculation with no external collaborators.
expected: Focus on deterministic inputs and output assertions without integration infrastructure.

prompt: A JUnit Jupiter test class mutates a field shared by test methods after adding PER_CLASS lifecycle. Review isolation and propose a deterministic regression check.
expected: Inspect JUnit test instance lifecycle and any extension/shared fixtures.
Keep state per test or reset it through a verified lifecycle boundary; do not rely on test order.
Run the affected test alone and with its class/suite to expose state leakage.

prompt: A pytest module uses a session-scoped mutable fixture that one test edits, changing results for later tests. Review fixture scope and setup/teardown.
expected: Load pytest fixture guidance and trace fixture scope/dependency edges.
Use isolated mutable values or narrower fixture scope unless shared state is intentional and reset.
Verify behavior across reordered and repeated tests without sleep-based synchronization.

prompt: A Mockito unit test verifies every private collaborator call in a pure pricing calculation. Review whether the test captures the contract and propose a more stable assertion.
expected: Load Mockito guidance because stubs and interaction verification are explicit.
Assert observable result and boundary effects only when they are contractual; avoid private decomposition/order assertions.
Prefer real simple collaborators or a focused fake over mocking every internal helper.
